name: Solar Industries India Ltd.
about: Solar Industries India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial explosives, explosive initiating devices, and high energy materials for mining and defense applications in India and internationally. The company offers industrial explosives comprising bulk, packaged, non-permitted, permitted, and seismic explosives; initiating systems; electronic, non-electric, and plain detonators; cord relays; cast boosters; detonating cords; and aluminum elemented det products. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~31% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~22% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 75 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 104), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 75 vs sector median 32; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 44, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
